cases.assertion: Every frontend route is private-listener-only and returns 404 on the Action listener.
Duplicate Host, Origin, contract, CSRF, or frontend-session values fail before authentication or application dispatch.
Cross-origin, malformed, oversized, wrong-media-type, or throttled login requests cannot invoke Argon2 verification.
A correct password creates one fixed seven-day session only after durable limiter and security-audit updates succeed.
Five peer failures and thirty global failures within fifteen minutes enforce the defined windows across ordinary restart.
Limiter read or outcome-write failure returns service_unavailable without verifying a password or issuing a cookie.
Login replacement atomically supersedes the represented old session and emits one unambiguous frontend cookie.
Session bootstrap returns only expires_at, remaining_seconds, and csrf_proof and does not extend or replace authority.
Ordinary restart preserves valid sessions while destructive restore or PITR cannot revive expired, revoked, or superseded sessions.
A protected response whose session becomes invalid before response release withholds protected payload.
Logout requires the represented lifecycle cookie plus exact CSRF proof and is idempotent after a lost successful response.
A stale logout response cannot revoke, clear, or overwrite a newer replacement login.
Login, reload, fixed local expiry, explicit logout retry, and return-target restoration preserve concealment rules.
Local logout or replacement clears active same-origin tabs within two seconds; page restore and suspension return bootstrap before reveal.
CSP, no-store, nosniff, CORP, COOP, referrer, permissions, cookie, HTTPS, and redirect behavior match the closed runtime contract.
Served frontend schema, generated client, implemented routes, cookie security scheme, CSRF header, and contract header remain synchronized without changing Action OpenAPI.
Provisioning and rotation share Unicode-code-point bounds, reject configured-secret equality, store only Argon2id verifier state, and invalidate all sessions transactionally.
